title: Pause poll while viewing history, resume on return to live
action: Per D4: add a 'viewing history' state that pauses poll() (terminal.ts:213-226, setInterval at :380) whenever the viewport is away from the live bottom, entered via the existing scroll-to-top loadOlder() trigger (terminal.ts:236-258). Per D4's discretion note, add a symmetric bottom-threshold check to the same scroll listener (mirroring HISTORY_SCROLL_THRESHOLD, terminal.ts:41) that resumes poll and calls void poll() immediately when the viewport returns near the bottom (per D7, same 'reflect promptly' pattern as terminal.ts:342,355). Per D6, opening the Reply or Keys sheet already calls applySheetInset() which forces viewport.scrollTop = viewport.scrollHeight (terminal.ts:284) -- that programmatic scroll must fire the same native 'scroll' event the bottom-threshold listener above handles, so no separate resume path is needed for sheet-open; do not add one. Do not touch the historyInFlight/historyArmed guard semantics (terminal.ts:172,178) -- the new pause state is additive, coordinated at the same point, per Established Patterns in CONTEXT.md. Update the existing test 'clamps scrollTop instead of leaving it stale when the next poll tick shrinks the content back down' (web/test/terminal.test.ts:298-321), which currently asserts the OLD (buggy) revert-on-next-poll-tick behavior this cell replaces -- change it to assert the long (history) content SURVIVES the next would-be poll tick unpaused, i.e. no revert happens while still scrolled away from the bottom. Add a new test asserting the D6 resume path: after scrolling to history, dispatch the mount's Reply-sheet-open interaction (or directly set scrollTop=scrollHeight and dispatch a 'scroll' event, matching the jsdom manual-dispatch pattern already used at web/test/terminal.test.ts:226-227,244-247) and assert the next poll tick fires and reverts to live content. Do not modify the existing 'never lets a poll tick interleave with an in-flight history-load request' test (web/test/terminal.test.ts:323-347) -- it must keep passing unmodified.

truths: poll() does not fetch/render the live screen while the viewport is away from the live bottom (history view survives, no snap-back within one tick)
poll() resumes automatically once the viewport returns near the bottom, whether by drag-scroll or by a programmatic scrollTop=scrollHeight assignment (e.g. from applySheetInset)
the historyInFlight in-flight guard (terminal.ts:172, tested at web/test/terminal.test.ts:323-347) is untouched and its test still passes

artifacts.substantive: poll() gated by a viewing-history/live-tail state; scroll listener extended with a symmetric bottom-threshold resume check
the revert-on-next-tick test rewritten for the new pause behavior; a new test covers the sheet-open resume path

key_links: terminal.ts's scroll listener (around :250-258) checks both the existing top threshold and a new bottom threshold
applySheetInset's forced scrollTop=scrollHeight (terminal.ts:284) triggers the same resume path as a manual drag-scroll to bottom
prohibitions: No change to src/web/screen.rs or any Rust backend file
No change to historyInFlight/historyArmed guard semantics
No weakening or deletion of the 'never lets a poll tick interleave with an in-flight history-load request' test
